senses.gloss:
mn. (-लः-लं)
A Tola, a weight of gold or silver: it is stated in books at 16 Māṣas of 5 Rattis or 6½ grains each, and weighs therefore 105 grains troy: in practice it is calculated at 12 Māṣas jeweller's weight, and weighs nearly double, or 210 grains; but actually it is of the same weight as the Sicca or grs. 179 (2/3).
E.
तुल to weigh, affix घञ्; also with ण्वुल् affix तोलक, mn. (-कः-कं.)

n. (-नं)
Weighing.
E.
तुल to weigh, ल्युट् aff.

ind.
Having weighed.
E.
तुल to weigh, causal form, त्त्वा aff.
